accepted_gaps.title: Habitat-resolved volume
accepted_gaps.statement: Volume, porosity, and connectivity are not jointly propagated into a common deep-biosphere inventory.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Report a posterior distribution for every compartment, not one unqualified global volume.

accepted_gaps.title: Abundance calibration
accepted_gaps.statement: Counts and molecular readouts have matrix-dependent bias and extracellular-DNA confounding.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Use paired counts, extraction controls, and cross-platform calibration.

accepted_gaps.title: Potential-to-rate bridge
accepted_gaps.statement: Functional genes and transcripts do not directly quantify realized redox rates.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Link multiomics to geochemistry and rate or reaction-transport constraints.

accepted_gaps.title: Native-signal preservation
accepted_gaps.statement: Coring, drilling, recovery, depressurization, and incubation can alter deep communities and chemistry.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Track blanks, in situ observatory context, pressure-temperature handling, and contamination lineage.

accepted_gaps.title: Global extrapolation
accepted_gaps.statement: Sites are unevenly distributed among oceanographic provinces and geological settings.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Use stratified hierarchical upscaling with coverage diagnostics.

accepted_gaps.title: Astrobiology transfer
accepted_gaps.statement: Earth deep-biosphere observations constrain energy-limited habitability but not extraterrestrial life occurrence.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Report analog conditions and falsifiable biosignature expectations separately.

rejected_inferences.inference: All deep ocean below 1000 m is 4 degrees C and 40--110 atmospheres.
rejected_inferences.reason: Temperature and pressure vary strongly with depth, circulation, and hydrothermal context.

rejected_inferences.inference: A cell count gives the carbon-cycle flux.
rejected_inferences.reason: Standing abundance and realized metabolism are different estimands.

rejected_inferences.inference: DNA or transcript abundance proves an active pathway.
rejected_inferences.reason: Preservation, extraction, and translation-to-rate uncertainty require independent constraints.

rejected_inferences.inference: A deep-sea analogue proves life elsewhere.
